This includes the following requirement
【Transaction Aggregation and On-Chain Commit】
・Daily Batch Processing
At a fixed time each day, all transactions that have occurred off-chain are aggregated.
A Merkle tree is constructed from the aggregated transactions, and the Merkle root (root hash) is calculated.
・ On-chain commitment of the Merkle root
The calculated Merkle root is committed to a smart contract on the Cardano blockchain.

This process records the day's transactions on the blockchain, ensuring the integrity of the entire system.

【User Verification of Transactions】
・Weekly Verification
Once a week, users verify that their transactions have been correctly reflected on-chain.
To do this, they use the corresponding Merkle proof and check it against the Merkle root on the smart contract.
